class.name: WiperListItem
class.brief_description: A single position of the wiper programmer table (WiperList).
class.description: Each [WiperListItem] corresponds to one line of the [code]WiperList[/code] table. Its index within [member TrainWipers.positions] corresponds to the switch position, starting from 0. [b]Not wired to the mover[/b] - see [TrainWipers].

members.member: [code]WiperList:D[/code] Delay before returning from the deflected position, in seconds.
[code]WiperList:B[/code] Time to travel from one side to the other, in seconds.
[code]WiperList:A[/code] Bitmask of active wipers at this position.
